title: Terrain-Aware Fixed-Line Planning for Multibeam Bathymetric Mapping Using Public Bathymetry Benchmarks
description: Manuscript-specific code, derived public-bathymetry benchmark outputs, figure-generation scripts, LaTeX sources, compiled PDFs, and SHA-256 reproducibility manifest for a public-grid numerical benchmark of terrain-aware depth-referenced MBES fixed-line planning. The package supports public GEBCO 2025 scenes, synthetic stress tests, a USGS Southern Cascadia 30 m public-grid extension, coarse-prior/fine-grid replay, execution-uncertainty replay, PSO and GA diagnostics, and sensitivity analyses. It does not claim sea-trial validation, mission-log validation, hydrographic-survey certification, navigation-safety readiness, or altitude-aware AUV execution.
